brief: Show the actual learning content and progression, using only attributed factual statements.

facts.text: The course is offered through JF Japanese e-Learning Minato, operated by the Japan Foundation.
Katsudoo develops practical communication; Rikai studies how Japanese is structured.
The course offers interactive self-study content and records study progress.
